schemeName: CSISAC scheme for least developed states
executiveSummary: A Project to complete computerization (Networking) of State Cooperative Bank through setting up of modern data centre at its Head Office and renovation of its existing building.

objectives: Complete centralize networking of HO and remote branches/Regional offices

riskAssessment.name: Delays in Renovation Work
riskAssessment.mitigation: Engage a reputable contractor and monitor progress regularly.
riskAssessment.evidence: [Chunk 9 - Page 3] Renovation of HO Building : Since the existing building is very old it needs urgent renovation work...

riskAssessment.name: Data Centre Setup Delays
riskAssessment.mitigation: Engage a consultant with experience in setting up data centres and ensure timely procurement of equipment.
riskAssessment.evidence: [Chunk 10 - Page 3] ii) Setting up Data Centre : A modern data centre is to be set up to complete centralize its networking...

riskAssessment.name: Power Outages
riskAssessment.mitigation: Install a backup power supply system and ensure regular maintenance of the SPV unit.
riskAssessment.evidence: [Chunk 11 - Page 3] iii) Installation of SPV Unit : The installation of SPV unit is proposed to ensure continuous uninterrupted power supply.

riskAssessment.name: Financial Constraints
riskAssessment.mitigation: Ensure timely disbursement of funds from NCDC and explore alternative funding sources if necessary.
riskAssessment.evidence: [Chunk 12 - Page 3] Project Cost & Means of Finance : The Total project cost is worked out to Rs. 40.60 cr...

riskAssessment.name: Security Risks
riskAssessment.mitigation: Implement robust security measures, including encryption and access controls, for the data centre.
riskAssessment.evidence: [Chunk 13 - Page 3] Security : The Bank will offer FDR/Govt. securities/Govt. Guarantee as security for the loan

riskAssessment.name: Project Cost Overruns
riskAssessment.mitigation: Regularly review and update project cost estimates to ensure that they remain aligned with actual costs.
riskAssessment.evidence: [Chunk 12 - Page 3] Project Cost & Means of Finance : The Total project cost is worked out to Rs. 40.60 cr...

riskAssessment.name: Dependence on NCDC Funding
riskAssessment.mitigation: Diversify funding sources and ensure that the project can be completed even if NCDC funding is delayed or withdrawn.
riskAssessment.evidence: [Chunk 12 - Page 3] Project Cost & Means of Finance : The Total project cost is worked out to Rs. 40.60 cr...

issues.description: Total project cost is Rs. 40.60 cr, but it should be the sum of Fixed Cost and Operational Cost (Rs. 39.68 cr + Rs. 0.74 cr = Rs. 40.42 cr)
The project is expected to be completed within a period of 1 year after sanction, but the loan from NCDC will take some time to process (Rs.26.39 cr in Chunk 17 - Page 3)
The Total project cost is mentioned as Rs. 40.60 cr in Chunk 12 - Page 3, but the loan from NCDC and subsidy are calculated based on a different total (Rs.26.39 cr + Rs.10.15 cr = Rs.36.54 cr)
The interest rate for the loan from NCDC is not mentioned

complianceGaps: Lack of clear details on environmental impact assessment
Unclear land acquisition process and compensation plan
Beneficiary alignment could be more specific
complianceStrengths: Good documentation quality with clear project details
Project has a clear focus on computerization and modernization of State Cooperative Bank
NCDC loan and subsidy details are provided
